# CoinMarketCap

CoinMarketCap provides a comprehensive cryptocurrency market data API, offering real-time and historical data on cryptocurrencies and exchanges.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/coinmarketcap/.

## Actions

- **Cryptocurrency Listings Latest** (read-only): Fetch the latest active cryptocurrency listings with their current market data.
- **Cryptocurrency Map** (read-only): Retrieve a mapping of all cryptocurrencies, including their unique IDs, symbols, and names.
- **Exchange Listings Historical** (read-only): Retrieve historical exchange listings for a specified date.
- **Exchange Map** (read-only): Retrieve a mapping of all cryptocurrency exchanges.
- **Get API Key Info** (read-only): Retrieve your CoinMarketCap API key details, rate limits, and usage statistics.
- **Get cryptocurrency info** (read-only): Fetch metadata (description, logo, URLs) for one or more cryptocurrencies.
- **Get exchange info** (read-only): Get detailed metadata for one or more exchanges.
- **Get Latest Cryptocurrency Quotes** (read-only): Get the latest market quotes for one or more cryptocurrencies.
- **Global Metrics Quotes Latest** (read-only): Obtain the latest global cryptocurrency market metrics (market cap, volume, dominance).
- **Partner Map** (read-only): Retrieve a mapping of all CoinMarketCap partners with their unique IDs, names, and slugs.
- **Price Conversion** (read-only): Convert an amount from one cryptocurrency or fiat currency into another.
